identification.summary: WET PANDA is a CrowdStrike-style 'PANDA' adversary name that appears as a listed synonym in a Malpedia entry for PALE PANDA, which cites CrowdStrike's 10 Feb 2015 Global Threat Intelligence Report; the same entry lists MAGNETIC SPIDER, PREDATOR PANDA, SABRE PANDA and SPICY PANDA as synonyms. [S2] The retrieved sources provide no description of WET PANDA activity. [S2]
identification.notes: The name mapping is Malpedia's and was not independently confirmed against the CrowdStrike report text; the entry does not establish what each listed name covers. [S2] The MISP Galaxy threat-actor cluster lists 'Red Chimera' as a synonym of WET PANDA, citing the same CrowdStrike report. [S4]

gaps: No vendor profile, campaign, malware, infrastructure or victimology for WET PANDA was found in open search results.
The CrowdStrike 2015 Global Threat Intelligence Report PDF (the lead URL in the actor record) was not opened; its treatment of WET PANDA is unverified.
Whether WET PANDA is truly a synonym of PALE PANDA, or a separate CrowdStrike cluster, is unresolved; do not merge facts across these names.
China nexus (country CN in the record) is inferred from the PANDA naming convention only and is not supported by a cited source here.
Sponsor, objectives, targeting, TTPs and timeline are all unknown from open sources reviewed.
The alias 'Red Chimera' comes only from a MISP Galaxy search snippet and was not verified against the CrowdStrike report.
Malpedia and MISP Galaxy pages were seen via search snippets only.
